actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB3k (explicit open request; set level, no words): press the mu2-constant even-half condition on (11,7)/(9,9), the new lead of PR 3108, and continue the (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) walk where budget allows. Delivered outcome=partial. (a) mu2 lead: the exact identity mu2 = |A+A| + |B+B| - |G| is PROVEN for every reduced cover (A,B) of G=F2^m (inclusion-exclusion on (A+A) u (B+B) = G), and validated at 0 violations over all 41,341 F2^3 covers. 'mu2 constant per split' is NOT a covering law: mu2 VARIES at a single minimal split, (4,4) in F2^3 (3,360 covers; mu2=6 for two generic halves with |A+A|=|B+B|=7, mu2=3 when exactly one half is an affine plane with |A+A|=4), with the mechanism characterized exactly (a structured affine-plane half lowers |A+A| and so mu2 by 3; at (4,6) in F2^4 the split is constant only because the two selfsum sizes are anti-correlated by the cover condition). No variation at F2^1 or F2^2 (complete). For the both-odd target regime (11,7)/(9,9), mu2 is constant at every both-odd split where covers can be produced (F2^3 complete; F2^5 (7,7) 310 covers, all mu2=12 with |A+A|=|B+B|=22) but this is CHECKED, not forced (F2^6 (9,9)/(11,7) covers were not produced in a bounded hill-climbing search, so mu2 variation at the target splits is neither observed nor ruled out). The (4,4) counterexample proves the covering condition does not pin mu2 in general, so the lead is DEMOTED as a proof filter: it cannot be carried to PR 2911's 501/196 rows and then to m=6 as a hard condition without a both-odd forcing proof (absent here). This is the same shape as PR 3034's demoted scale-dependent self-sum lift. (b) (4,2) walk: continued PR 3108's sharded walk with per-shard receipts (explicit complete/budget_hit flags, budget checked after every U); 30/2048 shards complete (29 inherited from PR 3108 plus shard 29 this session), 2490 U slices, 257845500 normalized pairs, w_candidates=0 and covering=0 on every walked pair, per-shard receipts with explicit complete/budget_hit flags and budget checked after every U; shard 29 re-run from empty receipts with identical counters to prove recomputation. The complete walk remains far outside one session (PR 3108 sized it at ~608 core-hours), so this is a budget-honest partial and not an exclusion. No class decided; no cover constructed; no false kill; frontiers unchanged.
bottleneck_link: The set-level restricted addition basis value r((C2)^7) decides how small a universal word's prefix set can be inside the unchanged PR943 query model. Under the concurrent word-level gap 22 <= f(7) <= 24 (PR 2973/3005), whether any 18-point set covers F2^7 is the deciding necessary condition for f(7) = 22. This package presses one named identity (the even-half mu2-constant condition) that PR 3108 proposed as the narrowed route to the both-odd splits (11,7)/(9,9) and shows it is not a covering law (demoted), removing one proposed filter; and it advances the (4,2) decision walk. It decides no split outright and changes no supplier, tariff or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: (a) mu2-constancy proved forced per split and contradicting (11,7)/(9,9) (excluding them), (b) mu2-constancy proved scale-dependent or a minimal varying split found (demoting the lead), (c) the (4,2) walk decided or its budget expiring with each class's exact status recorded. Outcome (b) reached for the mu2 lead (minimal varying split (4,4) F2^3, mechanism characterized) plus a budget-honest (4,2) walk continuation. One bounded pivot: the mu2 investigation (identity, minimality census, mechanism, both-odd search). No second pivot; the construction route and the (3,3) route were not re-entered.
smallest_falsifying_instance_first: The falsifying instance for 'mu2 is forced per split' is one split carrying two covers with different mu2; the smallest such is (4,4) in F2^3, found by complete enumeration after confirming F2^1 and F2^2 have none. The identity mu2 = sa+sb-|G| was validated first (0 violations over 41,341 F2^3 covers). The mechanism was then read off the (4,4) clusters (structured vs generic halves) and cross-checked at (4,6) F2^4 (anti-correlated selfsums, constant sum). Both-odd constancy was tested at the smallest both-odd scales where covers exist (F2^3 complete; F2^5 (7,7) mutation search) before any claim about (11,7)/(9,9). All recorded anchors were reproduced before any new number (PR 2870 OBSTRUCTION 696/504/192, PR 2933 CLASSIFY tight=2 cases=6720, PR 2961 FOURIER (7,1) need=175 lower=239 recomputed live; PR 2961 CLASS82/CLASS60 and PR 3023 AV51 read back; PR 3108 SELFSUM (5,5)/(7,7) profiles (8,8,8) and CENSUS33 (3,3) covers=296,352 read back).

open_questions.question: Decide whether both-odd mu2 is forced at F2^6 for the (11,7)/(9,9) splits.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A both-odd counterexample (two (9,9) or (11,7) covers with different mu2) closes the mu2 lead for good; a pinned value would license a sound row filter and could exclude a split if the value is unrealizable.
open_questions.first_step: Produce a reduced (9,9) or (11,7) cover of F2^6 (construct one explicitly) and vary |A+A| to see whether mu2 moves; the F2^3 (4,4) mechanism (a structured half) is the template.
open_questions.blocked_by: Both-odd F2^6 covers are rare (none produced in a bounded hill-climbing search); no constructive generator is known.

open_questions.question: Characterize which splits force the selfsum correlation (constant mu2) versus independence (varying mu2).
open_questions.why_it_matters: At F2^4 (4,6) the two selfsum sizes are anti-correlated by the cover condition (constant mu2=4), while at F2^3 (4,4) they vary independently (mu2 in 3..6). A criterion would say exactly when mu2 is usable.
open_questions.first_step: Test whether the (4,6)-type correlation holds at (2k,2l) both-even splits versus (4,k) splits, and prove or refute a coupling between |A+A| and |B+B| from A+B=G.
open_questions.blocked_by: The correlation has no proved coupling identity; it is observed at (4,6) F2^4 only.

open_questions.question: Carry any sound both-odd condition to PR 2911's 501/196 surviving rows.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 501/196 rows are the concrete surviving (11,7)/(9,9) configurations; a sound mu2 (or other even-half) filter on them would narrow or decide those splits.
open_questions.first_step: Build the row-to-cover map (PR 2773/2911 pair-representation rows to concrete (A,B)) and evaluate mu2 on the 501/196 rows.
open_questions.blocked_by: The row-to-cover map and both-odd forcing are both open; mu2 is not a proven filter, so applying it to the rows is unsound as a proof step.
